summary: Software Update Package 6.1.1 is a compatibility and reliability update.

We are pleased to introduce Software Update Package SUP 6.1.0. for all camera models in the ALEXA 35 family: ALEXA 35, ALEXA 35 Xtreme, ALEXA 35 Live, and ALEXA 35 Live Xtreme. This release introduces Picture-in-Picture Tracking Zoom, a new variation of the Tracking Zoom feature first introduced for the ALEXA 35 Xtreme in SUP 5.2.0.
We are pleased to announce the release of ALEXA Mini LF Software Update Package SUP 7.3.2.

ALEXA LF SUP 4.3 This update includes useful enhancements to the usability of the monitoring overlays and the use of the ALEXA LF camera with ARRI Rental DNA and Cooke /i lenses. This includes a fix for the orange line bug and the replacement of the MAGNIFICATION indication orange line/outline by MAGNIFICATION icons in the status area to the right of the image.

This Software Update Package is a maintenance release and includes important bug fixes and support for modified hardware parameters. For all ALEXA Mini owners we recommend updating to SUP 6.1.2. We highly recommend that you take your time to go through the Release Notes before you start using the camera.
